Let \(t=x+\frac52\). Then

\[
(x+1)(x+2)(x+3)(x+4)
= \left(t^2-\frac94\right)\left(t^2-\frac14\right).
\]

Let \(u=t^2\ge 0\). Then

\[
f(u)=\left(u-\frac94\right)\left(u-\frac14\right)
= u^2-\frac52u+\frac{9}{16}.
\]

This quadratic in \(u\) is minimized at \(u=\frac54\), giving

\[
f_{\min}=\frac{25}{16}-\frac{25}{8}+\frac{9}{16}=-1.
\]

Thus the minimum of the original expression is

\[
-1+2019=2018.
\]

\[
\boxed{2018}
\]
